checked_by: Claude (two sessions): drafted from match_overview, death_context and lane_report on the rebuilt trace; every fact re-read independently by the session that built the support tools. The owner delegated the check.
source: Tool outputs on the trace rebuilt from the archived replay, with the match record (match_overview, death_context, lane_report). Ward and save counts from the ward_report / save_report branch (#358), quoted for context, not anchored: those refs are not on main yet. Drafted for the support tools; not yet checked against a second reading.

must_hit.says: Five of the seven deaths were outside any fight and no enemy died within 15 s of them (10:16, 15:52, 37:42, 55:20, 55:51); at 10:16 and 55:51 no ally was within 2200.
At 10:16 and 55:51 the death window began at full health with Static Storm ready, and it was not cast.

must_not.says: Disruptor placed 10 observers and 34 sentries — the most observers on the team (Dark Willow 9, Sniper 2, Omniknight 0, Sven 0), above the 7 the two most-warding heroes of a team place at the median (ward_report reference). A review must not say there were too few wards.
must_not.pattern: (?:假眼|真眼|眼位|插眼|视野)[^。]{0,10}(?:太少|不够|很少|偏少|少了|几乎没有)|(?:too few|not enough|barely any|very few)[^.]{0,12}(?:wards|observers|vision)

must_not.says: Help given to an ally under fire did not change their five-second death rate in the corpus (13% vs 14%; 25% vs 31% under 300+ damage): a review must not say a cast saved, or should have saved, an ally.
must_not.pattern: (?:本可以|本该|应该|能)[^。]{0,8}救(?:下|住|活)|(?:should have|could have) saved
